Splitting into 2 separate vaults requires a separate funded vault account and a separate escrow deposit for each, and thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence since the orchard binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 374 account operation therefore ties up 36 million dollars of idle capital. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
